name: @pipeworx/mcp-datacite

tools.name: search_dois
tools.description: Search DataCite-registered DOIs (research datasets, software, etc.). Filter by free-text query, resource type, year, publisher, or affiliation, and SORT by relevance, recency, citations, downloads, or views — e.g. "most-downloaded climate datasets" (sort=downloads), "newest genomics datasets" (sort=recent), "most-cited datasets on X" (sort=citations). Returns DOI, title, creators, publisher, type, year, and citation/download/view counts.

resource_type.description: Dataset | Software | Text | Image | Sound | Other (case-sensitive)

sort.description: Result ordering: relevance (default), recent (newest registered), oldest, published (newest publication year), citations (most-cited), downloads (most-downloaded), views (most-viewed).

tools.name: get_doi
tools.description: Fetch a single DOI record. Returns full metadata: title(s), creators with affiliations and ORCIDs, abstract, publisher, year, dates, related identifiers, subjects, license, sizes/formats.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List DataCite-registered data repositories (e.g., Zenodo, Dryad, Figshare). Filter by query. Useful for "where do I deposit a dataset" lookups.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datacite forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datacite pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
